ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the M1-2,
Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 2-1 in the area bound by:

West Lexington Street; South Washtenaw Avenue; the alley next south of West
Lexington Avenue; a line 115.25 feet west of and parallel to South Washtenaw Avenue,
West Polk Street; a line 165.09 feet west of South Washtenaw Avenue; the alley next
south of West Lexington Avenue; and a line 115.19 feet west of and parallel to South
Washtenaw Avenue,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

4Y4son C. Ervin
Alderman, 28" Ward

Common Address:
2701-2711 W. Lexington Street
2712-2714 W. Polk Street
